params.body:
Removes duplicates. Two small behaviour changes, both fixes:

- **Analytics shows the model name for Opus 5 and Fable 5.** It showed "?" for them. `PHASE_META` and `MODEL_LABELS` existed in both Analytics and ModelRouting, and the Analytics copy had fallen behind. Both now come from `src/models.js`, and both use `labelFor`.
- **The review queue now stays put when a save fails.** ReviewQueue had its own `storePatch` that never checked the response, so a failed save moved on to the next insight as if it had been saved. It now uses the one in `useData`, which throws. The queue stays on the item and the console logs the error.

Moved without changes:
- The country-to-region map and its counting loop (Insights and Patterns) are now `countByRegion` in `taxonomy.js`.
- `classifyPlatform` (Insights and SourceDistribution) is now `src/platforms.js`.
- `PLATFORM_COLORS` in Insights was unused and is removed.

Checks: the lint ratchet is at its ceiling (42), the build passes, and all 21 Playwright tests pass.
params.title: One of each: labels, region counting, source kind, save
